description_en: Deletes the data synchronization link for a disaster recovery (DR) ApsaraDB RDS instance and promotes the DR instance to the primary instance
description_zh: 该接口用于删除RDS灾备实例的数据同步链路，并将灾备实例提升为主实例
kebab_example: aliyun rds delete-replication-link --db-instance-id m-2zecuz9tolf000000 --promote-to-master true --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteReplicationLink

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DR instance
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete the data synchronization link between the DR instance and the primary instance and promote the DR instance to the primary instance. Valid values:

true
false
parameters.help_zh:
是否删除主实例和灾备实例间的数据同步链路，并提升灾备实例为主实例，取值：

true：是
false：否
parameters.name: promote_to_master
